description: PLACEHOLDER ROW -- the entire fastener, bearing and hardware schedule
notes: The source spreadsheet carries one row reading "example: fasteners, nuts", priced at $0.00 with no vendor and no quantity. Every screw, nut, washer, bearing, dowel pin and threadlocker in a 31-DoF, 36 kg machine is behind that one row. The $0.00 is replaced here by a blank so that it is skipped by the cost macros instead of being silently summed as zero: the true fastener cost is unknown, not nil.
